info.name: Gravita API
info.description: Full REST API surface for the Gravita ERP/tax backend, generated from every @RestController under br.gravita.adapters.inbound.controllers. Organized by module (auth, users, customers, products, master data, inventory, purchasing, tax/PDV, NF-e). Set the baseUrl collection variable and populate the resource id variables (customerId, productId, etc.) captured from earlier responses as you exercise each flow.
